findings.before: All three queued→running, awaiting→queued, running→awaiting tests lost cancellation because the stale status determined the only CAS path.
findings.fix: Persist cancellation intent for every live state, reload current state and prevent claims after the cancellation fence.

findings.before: A queued run with cancellation intent could start, and cancellation interrupted before settlement otherwise left it blocking later runs.
findings.fix: Prevent its claim and let scheduler reconciliation finish queued cancellations even without an approval broker.

findings.before: Deterministic GORM after-read interleaving deleted the automation after authorization; RunNow still returned success and queued orphan work.
findings.fix: Lock the active parent before checking busy state and creating a manual run, in one transaction; concurrent deletion now prevents enqueue.
